testedLayer: Real Hono POST admission and SSE routes, production ConversationService Redis rate admission, DrizzleConversationStore.submit + conversationAdmission + wallet/capability/rate/capacity PostgreSQL queries, and real Redis stream leases. Admission timing starts before the POST route and ends after its successful response, including auth revalidation, Redis request limiting, source auth, transaction commit and queued-job/event persistence. It excludes TCP/proxy buffering, credential cryptography and provider latency. Synthetic fixture never dispatches providers.

select
        coalesce(g.queued,0) as global_queued, coalesce(a.queued,0) as actor_queued,
        coalesce(g.running,0) as global_running, coalesce(a.running,0) as actor_running,
        (select min(created_at) from text_ai_capacity_jobs where state='queued' and runnable
            and next_attempt_at<=$1::timestamptz) as oldest_runnable_at
        from (select 1) singleton
        left join text_ai_capacity_queue_totals g on g.scope='global'
        left join text_ai_capacity_queue_totals a on a.scope=$2

with settled as (
        select scope, sum(cost) as cost, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens
        from text_ai_capacity_settled_buckets where scope in ('global',$1) and cohort=$2
            and minute>=$3::timestamptz group by scope
        union all
        select 'global', coalesce(sum(cost),0), coalesce(sum(input_tokens),0), coalesce(sum(output_tokens),0)
        from text_ai_capacity_provider_usage where cohort=$4 and state='settled'
            and settled_at>$5::timestamptz and settled_at<$6::timestamptz
        union all
        select $7, coalesce(sum(cost),0), coalesce(sum(input_tokens),0), coalesce(sum(output_tokens),0)
        from text_ai_capacity_provider_usage where cohort=$8 and state='settled' and owner_id=$9::uuid
            and settled_at>$10::timestamptz and settled_at<$11::timestamptz
    ), amounts as (
        select scope, true as active, cost, input_tokens, output_tokens from text_ai_capacity_active_totals
            where scope in ('global',$12) and cohort=$13
        union all select scope, false, cost, input_tokens, output_tokens from settled
    ) select
        coalesce(sum(cost) filter(where active and scope='global'),0) as global_active_cost,
        coalesce(sum(input_tokens) filter(where active and scope='global'),0) as global_active_input,
        coalesce(sum(output_tokens) filter(where active and scope='global'),0) as global_active_output,
        coalesce(sum(cost) filter(where not active and scope='global'),0) as global_settled_cost,
        coalesce(sum(input_tokens) filter(where not active and scope='global'),0) as global_settled_input,
        coalesce(sum(output_tokens) filter(where not active and scope='global'),0) as global_settled_output,
        coalesce(sum(cost) filter(where active and scope=$14),0) as owner_active_cost,
        coalesce(sum(input_tokens) filter(where active and scope=$15),0) as owner_active_input,
        coalesce(sum(output_tokens) filter(where active and scope=$16),0) as owner_active_output,
        coalesce(sum(cost) filter(where not active and scope=$17),0) as owner_settled_cost,
        coalesce(sum(input_tokens) filter(where not active and scope=$18),0) as owner_settled_input,
        coalesce(sum(output_tokens) filter(where not active and scope=$19),0) as owner_settled_output from amounts

plans.query:
select
        coalesce(g.queued,0) as global_queued, coalesce(a.queued,0) as actor_queued,
        coalesce(g.running,0) as global_running, coalesce(a.running,0) as actor_running,
        (select min(created_at) from text_ai_capacity_jobs where state='queued' and runnable
            and next_attempt_at<=$1::timestamptz) as oldest_runnable_at
        from (select 1) singleton
        left join text_ai_capacity_queue_totals g on g.scope='global'
        left join text_ai_capacity_queue_totals a on a.scope=$2

limitations: In-process Hono streaming excludes TCP/proxy buffering.
All100subscriptions use active125ms polling cadence;10running+90queued turns from real store admission/claim. No worker/provider dispatch occurs.

One million historical rows are immutable zero-amount policy-update ledger facts across the same active owners. Settled actions are only the real baseline admissions; this does not establish million-action/allocation/provider-history performance.
No provider or generation worker throughput claim.
pg_stat_activity lock samples are sampled waiter counts, not exact lock duration.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE captures each distinct admission SELECT, including locking queries. Trigger internals need separate SQL review.
